Loki 3.6.x cannot safely take github.com/prometheus/prometheus@v0.311.3 yet. The fixed Prometheus line in 3.7 drops github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/errors, which Loki 3.6.x still imports, and further source incompatibilities appear after patching that import (chunkenc.Iterator and PromQL parser API changes). Waiting for an upstream/source-compatible fix or backport path before bumping this track.

GHSA-fw8g-cg8f-9j28 is an XSS class issue in the Prometheus web UI (static assets and React/graph helpers under web/ui). Metrics-server vendors github.com/prometheus/prometheus only for library packages used by the controller binary and does not ship the Prometheus web UI, handlers, or frontend files, matching the pattern in vex/debian/prometheus-web-ui.vex.json.

CVE-2026-42154 affects the Prometheus server's remote read HTTP handler (/api/v1/read) for snappy-compressed payloads. Metrics-server is not a Prometheus server process and does not expose the Prometheus remote-read endpoint, so the vulnerable handler is not in the executable request path for this image.

CVE-2026-42151 concerns Azure AD remote-write OAuth credentials being exposed via the Prometheus server's /-/config HTTP API. DHI metrics-server builds a standalone controller binary; it does not run the Prometheus TSDB server or serve Prometheus operational endpoints, so that configuration surface is never reachable in this image.

This advisory is a stored XSS class issue in the Prometheus interactive web UI assets under web/ui. The adapter container does not ship or execute the Prometheus web UI or its frontend bundles.

CVE-2026-42154 affects unauthenticated requests to the Prometheus remote-read HTTP endpoint (/api/v1/read) on a running Prometheus server. This image does not run the Prometheus server or expose that API surface; github.com/prometheus/prometheus is linked only as a Go dependency for metrics-related libraries used by the adapter.

CVE-2026-42151 affects the Prometheus HTTP configuration endpoint (/-/config) when Azure AD remote-write OAuth is configured, exposing client_secret because the field was not modeled as a Secret type. The keda-metrics-apiserver image ships only the metrics adapter binary built from cmd/adapter; it does not run the Prometheus server or expose /-/config or remote-write storage endpoints.

Companion advisory for CVE-2026-42151 on the Prometheus module vendored via Grafana Loki. Promtail retains Loki's upstream prometheus pin because v0.311.3 breaks the module graph; promtail does not execute the affected Prometheus server XSS surface.

Promtail is built from Grafana Loki and retains Loki's upstream prometheus pseudo-version pin. Adopting prometheus v0.311.3 breaks the Loki module graph (removed/moved packages). The promtail binary uses a limited client-side subset of Prometheus libraries; the server-side code paths associated with this CVE are not exercised in this image.

Finding targets Prometheus server remote-read: unauthenticated DoS via crafted Snappy bodies on /api/v1/read. Tempo does not serve Prometheus' TSDB remote-read endpoint; vulnerable HTTP handlers are not part of Tempo's exposed surface.

Finding targets Prometheus server behavior: the Azure AD OAuth client_secret for remote_write is exposed via Prometheus' HTTP /-/config API. This DHI image builds Grafana Tempo, which links Prometheus packages for metrics and querying; it does not run the Prometheus server or expose that configuration API.
